scope: Authoring and release preflight. This policy does not activate a new learner evaluator or certify model-authored transformations.

types.purpose: Interpret meaning, reference or a contrast.
types.evidence: A selection or explanation establishes receptive evidence only.

types.purpose: Retrieve a previously encountered form or relation without the solution.
types.evidence: Record identity and exposure; a new example is not familiar-item recall for FSRS.

types.purpose: Repair a specific error while retaining the intended message.
types.evidence: Accept multiple licensed repairs; keep the original response and targeted error.

types.purpose: Re-express a message under explicit structural and semantic constraints.
types.evidence: Check participants, predicate, time, polarity and modality; record changed focus. A claimed semantic record is not an assessment.

types.purpose: Produce an answer under limited lexical or contextual choices.
types.evidence: Closed variants need review; a cloze alone does not prove spontaneous use.

types.purpose: Produce an original message for a communicative purpose.
types.evidence: Require target opportunity, relevance and qualified open assessment; do not grade against one model sentence.

types.purpose: Respond contingently to another turn and resolve a communicative need.
types.evidence: Require a preceding turn and contingent response. Recording a monologue does not establish interaction.

partitionRule: Template and scenario IDs connect variants globally, including declared translations. Normalised content matches connect items within a language. Connections are transitive. A connected family shared by learning and held-out material, exposed held-out material, or calibration and evaluation is quarantined. Evaluation material is never selected as practice. Unregistered semantic paraphrases still require independent review.
authoringRule: Generate from teaching/practice sources only. Register new template/scenario IDs before authoring; recheck the complete partition manifest after any change. Renaming an ID does not erase content-based exposure.
transformationReview: Validate grammatical feasibility and meaning in context. Passive conversion is not a universal transformation for intransitive predicates. Reduced purpose clauses need a licensed controller. Changed modality, negation, temporal relation or participants invalidates an equivalence claim.
interactionStatus: Explicit requirement; current generated single-response tasks provide no interaction evidence. Author dialogue tasks in L01/L03.
